notes: Transcribed from the Tanoshii "TV mimikara N3" PDF flashcard book (880 words across 12 lessons/"bai").

280 of 880 words additionally have an example sentence merged in (by shared stt numbering) from the separate "280 Dong tu N3 cach nho" PDF, which only covers the verb-lesson subset of this word list; 187 of those also have mnemonic text (the source book leaves mnemonic blank for some entries, keeping only the example).

2026-09-14: meaningVi refined via Gemini for richer/more natural phrasing (713/880 changed, 167 kept as-is). Every change was cross-verified by a second independent Gemini pass against the source word -- 25 flagged as risky (added a non-primary/misleading nuance, or in 2 cases the ORIGINAL meaning was outright wrong: 思い出 was mistranslated as the verb sense 'nhớ lại' instead of the correct noun 'kỷ niệm, hồi ức'; 協調 was confused with the similar word 強調 and mistranslated as 'nhấn mạnh' instead of 'hợp tác, phối hợp') were hand-corrected individually instead of taking either the old or new machine value as-is.
